top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs Buchwald and Hartwig for Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling (clean attribution, thirty years of confirmation, wide use in pharma and materials, and a distinct ligand-design solution to C-N reductive elimination) with Liu alone for base editing, the adenine editor's evolved TadA being a genuinely new chemical step. If the base-editing half is judged immature, P004 (C-N coupling alone) is my second choice. Degradation-only awards rank lower because the cereblon/glue strand is left unattributed and no degrader is yet an approved drug; phase separation is contested in vivo.
